english.title: Contravene an emergency prohibition made under the Food and Environment Protection Act 1985
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened an emergency prohibition, namely **(..SPECIFY PROHIBITION..), specified in Schedule 1 to the Food and Environment Protection Act 1985 in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1(6)(a) and 21(1) and (2) of the Food and Environment Protection Act 1985.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravene emergency prohibition
specified in Schedule 1 to the Food and Environment Protection Act 1985

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Under section 1(7) of the Food and Environment Protection Act 1985, it shall be a defence for a person charged under this section to show that the contravention took place on a foreign vessel, foreign aircraft, foreign hovercraft or foreign marine structure, and that nothing to which the prohibition related was landed from it in the United Kingdom.
(ii) Section 2(2) of the Food and Environment Protection Act 1985, it shall be a defence for a person charged under this section to show that consent had been given under section 2(1) to the contravention of the emergency prohibition, and that any condition subject to which that consent was given was complied with.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
